questions.q: Are you registered, and can I check?
questions.a: Yes. Our registers are linked under the services; each link goes to the scheme's own public register.

questions.q: Will the work be notified, and do I get certificates?
questions.a: Yes. Notifiable work is notified under Part P and you get the certificates when we finish. Keep them: you'll need them when you sell.

questions.q: Can you add lighting control without chasing walls?
questions.a: Often, yes: wireless control replaces the switch in its own box. In a new build or a full rewire we wire it in. We'll say which suits your house at the first visit.

questions.q: What happens if the Wi-Fi drops?
questions.a: The keypads keep working. They talk to each other on their own system; the app is the extra.

questions.q: Can we stay in the house during a rewire?
questions.a: Usually, yes. We work a floor or a few rooms at a time and leave power on where we can each evening.

questions.q: Can I get a grant for a charger?
questions.a: Some renters and flat owners can. The amounts change, so check gov.uk; the link is on our car charger page.

questions.q: How often do I need an EICR?
questions.a: For a home you own, we suggest every ten years. If you let it, in England the law asks for every five years; see the rules on gov.uk.
